status: compact-layout capacity projection, not implemented or validated on 1-CGRA hardware
method: Apply the archived multicore P1_LOCAL/P1_ALIGN layout equations to 1, 2 and 4 lanes, then round each memory to a power-of-two word count. This is not a live-range allocator proof.
conditions: The existing multicore code only accepts 2 or 4 CGRAs. The 1-lane extension here evaluates capacity equations, not the runnable program.
To use this as an implementation result, relocate all single-core kernel, DMA and configuration addresses consistently and verify correctness, liveness and port/bank behavior.
Recompute all GPT AE values if changing the 1-CGRA per-task reference area. No accepted table or figure has been changed.
